embed.description: Shows a video or social post from another site: the cell holds its link (YouTube, Vimeo, X or any page that can be framed). Add an image above the link to show a cover with a play button until it is clicked.
embed.html:
Embed, a video

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YE7VzlLtp-4

Embed, with a cover image

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YE7VzlLtp-4

form.description: A form built from a spreadsheet: the first link is the form's sheet published as .json on this site (one row per field: Name, Type, Label, Placeholder, Mandatory and so on), the second is the address that receives the answers.
form.structureOnly: it builds its fields from the form spreadsheet published on the storefront (the .json link), which exists only on a real site.

hero-v2.description: A large banner image with a text panel on the right. In the one cell: the image, then a heading, a subheading, a short line and a link; make the link bold to show it as a button.
hero-v2.html:
Hero V2

New season, new arrivals

Fresh styles for every day

Discover the latest pieces in our collection, in store and online.

Shop now

product-teaser.description: One product as a card: image, name, price and buttons, for the SKU you give. Each row is a setting and its value: SKU, then Details Button and Cart Button set to true to show each button.
product-teaser.structureOnly: it shows a product from the storefront's own catalog by SKU; on its own the image and details are empty.

quote.description: A quotation set apart from the page. The first row is the quote; the optional second row is who said it, with any part in italics shown as the source.
quote.html:
Quote

The fit is perfect, and after a year of wear it still looks new.

Sam, verified buyer

Quote, a longer review without attribution

I ordered on a Monday and it arrived on Wednesday, packed with care. The quality is better than I expected for the price, and I have already ordered a second one in another colour.

search.description: A search box that finds pages on this site as the shopper types. An optional link names the index to search (default /query-index.json); add the minimal style to list the results as plain text without images.

table.description: A table of rows and columns. The first row is the header, unless the style is no header; the striped style shades every other row and the bordered style draws a line around each cell.
